Answers to the most common questions about Vivapp.
How do I scan a product?
Tap Start scanning on the home screen and point the camera at the QR code on the product label. Turn on the flashlight in dark places, or use Scan from photo to read a code from an image.
Why is a code not recognised?
Vivapp reads the QR codes on catalogue product labels. If a code is damaged or belongs to a different product, tap Pick from list and search for the item instead.
Can I add items without scanning?
Yes. Open View all products (or Pick from list) and search by name, SAP number or category.
How do I change or remove an item?
Open your list and use + and – to adjust quantities. Tap the remove icon to delete an item – you can tap Undo right after.
How do I send my list?
On the list screen tap Send CSV and choose e-mail or any other app. The CSV contains the date, SAP number, category and quantity of each item.
The list is kept while the app is open. Send your CSV before closing the app so you don\'t lose your count.
Do I need an internet connection?
No. The product catalogue is stored on your device, so you can scan and count anywhere. Only sending the CSV needs the app you share it with.
How do I change the language?
Tap the globe icon in the top bar and pick English, Deutsch, Français or Italiano. Product names change with the language.
Still need help? Use Rate & give feedback in the ⋮ menu to tell us.
